bag_scope: Read-only streaming of original odom/depth/VIO status through supervisor and reset/control callbacks; explicit cache markers test invalidation. Not full perception replanning, actuator replay, or fixed physical trajectories.

five_bags_vio.scope:
Stream real bag timing through the VIO supervisor and map/control reset callbacks.

Does not replay topics or construct a robot backend/SDK. Cache markers explicitly
exercise invalidation; this is not full perception replanning or physical replay.

five_bags_control.scope: Recorded path conversion only; not a closed-loop physical replay

simulation_scope: combined scale .5 seed 7, 1.2 m flight and platform; full matrix injects at 3 s, extra one-floor tasks inject at 15 s while pitched. Human acknowledgement explicitly simulated by harness. No truth pose jumps, no removed safety assertions.
known_limitations: Five bags include manual intervention with no exact takeover timestamps.
Slow drift, pure attitude jumps and all calibration failures are not covered.
SDK/DDS delay and real braking distance are unmeasured.
Open-door landing problems from previous validation remain unvalidated/unresolved.
